name: req2code
description: Map plain-English requirements to the methods that implement them, live, offline, in any repository.

req2code.enginePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to your **req2code checkout** (the folder containing `scripts/mcp_server.py`). Leave blank to auto-detect when the open workspace *is* that checkout.

req2code.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter to run the engine with. Leave blank to use `.venv` inside the engine path, falling back to `python`.

req2code.autoStart.description: Start the engine when a workspace opens.

req2code.orphanThreshold.description: Score below which a method is treated as unclaimed. Uncalibrated — read it against the distribution shown in the Orphans tab.

req2code.topK.description: How many methods a trace returns.

req2code.codeLens.enabled.description: Show the best-matching requirement above each method.

req2code.statusPollSeconds.description: How often the panel refreshes index status. Each poll also re-syncs the index with the repository.
